candidates.summary: crypto/bls12381 joins stdlibs.InitOrder(), but stdlibs reach a chain's store only in InitChainer; a node booting this binary on a store written by an earlier binary panics in VMKeeper.Initialize, and the package is never importable on such a chain
candidates.failure_scenario: mainnet.gno.land and onyx upgrade in place (upgrades.json: halt_height plus halt_min_version, same data dir). The base stdlib set equals v1.6.0's (diff of gnomod.toml paths, rc=0), so crypto/bls12381 is the first stdlib past the deployed set. On the first boot of a binary carrying it, VMKeeper.Initialize (run by NewAppWithOptions before checkNodeStartupParams) loops over InitOrder, GetMemPackage("crypto/bls12381") returns nil, and TypeCheckMemPackage(nil) dereferences mpkg.Path (gotypecheck.go:198 from keeper.go:218): every validator fails to start after the halt. With that guarded, the package is still absent from the store, so a realm importing crypto/bls12381 (the PR's IBC light client) cannot be added on any chain not started from a fresh genesis. Neither the ADR (its consequences list the apphash move only) nor the PR names a migration loading the new stdlib at the upgrade height.
